# Vangcur (ভাঙচুর) — Gadgets & Accessories

> Vangcur is a premier e-commerce brand in Bangladesh specializing in unique gadgets, RGB lighting, crystal items, lifestyle tech, and mobile accessories with fast home delivery and warranty support across all 64 districts.

## About Vangcur
- [Official Website](https://vangcur.com): Official e-commerce store for gadgets and lifestyle accessories in Bangladesh.
- [Facebook Page](https://facebook.com/vangcurgadgets): Official Facebook page for updates, customer queries, and announcements.
- [Facebook Community Group](https://facebook.com/groups/vangcurgadgets): Community group for gadget enthusiasts and customer discussions.
- [Customer Support WhatsApp](https://wa.me/8801897804055): Direct WhatsApp helpline (+8801897804055) available 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM.

## Product Categories
- [RGB & Neon Lights](https://vangcur.com/category/rgb): Ambient LED decor, custom neon desk lights, and smart lighting solutions.
- [TWS Earbuds & Audio](https://vangcur.com/category/tws): Wireless Bluetooth earphones, neckbands, and audio gear.
- [Power Banks & Charging](https://vangcur.com/category/powerbank): Fast chargers, high-capacity portable power banks, and durable cables.
- [Smart Watches](https://vangcur.com/category/smartwatch): Health tracking, fitness monitoring, and lifestyle smartwatches.
- [Crystal Balls & Lamps](https://vangcur.com/category/crystalball): Decorative crystal art lamps, Moon lamps, and acrylic night lights.
- [Desk Fans & Humidifiers](https://vangcur.com/category/fan): Rechargeable cooling fans, desk mist humidifiers, and lifestyle electronics.
- [Unique Tools & Gadgets](https://vangcur.com/category/unique): Portable mini printers, unique utility tools, and desktop gadgets.
